services.desc: If you want to challenge, reward, incentivise or simply re-energise your team we can create a package for you. Captain Gerry (A.A., B.A., B.ED.) has professional development training and will be happy to discuss the possibilities with you. We have over 40 years’ experience in providing solutions for commercial and scientific crews in challenging marine environments. We offer expert advice on marine locations, wildlife and tidal information combined with competitive pricing. Our vessels provide a stable working platform, good storage, ample working deck space, excellent maneuverability, with the added safety and operational advantages of custom aluminum construction.
